title: Leaf and fruit spot disease on citrus - Uganda

Header: Leaf and fruit spot disease on citrus - Uganda

Prevention: Do not plant species of citrus in the same fields.
Restrict materials – manure, crop residues from affected fields.
Plant wind breaks around the orchard.
Prune shoots that have die back to allow light penetration and free aeration.
Monitoring: Inspect your orchard regularly for disease symptoms.
Check for dark brown spots with yellow halos on leaves and fruits.
High humid conditions increase the incidence of the disease and when it is high consider direct control.
Spray when the first symptoms are observed on the trees.
Direct Control: Collect and destroy all fallen fruit in affected orchards by burning.
Remove leaves and branches with severe symptoms of the disease and burn them.
Restrictions: Use protective clothing when using pesticides.
Follow the instructions on the product label, such as dosage, timing of application, pre-harvest interval, max number of sprays, restricted re-entry interval.
U; Unlikely to present acute hazard in normal use.
